from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, os, signal, time, json, hashlib, statistics

r = Path.cwd()
t = r / '.local/tool-tasks/small-pile-incremental-projection-20261009'
assert json.loads((t / 'native-corrected/result.json').read_text())['status'] == 'Passed'
builds = {'A': r / '.local/tool-tasks/two-card-projection-revalidation-20261009/build-candidate/CombatSolver.dll',
          'C': t / 'build-candidate/CombatSolver.dll'}
host = r / '.local/tool-tasks/native-sort-storage-20261008/harness/OfflineSearchHarness.dll'
requests = Path('/home/ltlly/Code/nmslmod/CombatSolver-perf-20261001/.local/veryhigh-dop16/frozen-corpus/requests')
sequence = ['A1', 'C1', 'C2', 'A2']
run_records, summaries = [], []
work_keys = ['totalExpanded', 'totalTransitions', 'totalChoiceBranches']
for scene, nodes in [('dev-06-silent-boss', 500000), ('dev-08-regent-boss', 500000)]:
    scene_records = []
    for label in sequence:
        out = t / 'full' / scene / label
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        dll = builds[label[0]]
        cmd = ['dotnet', str(host), '--request', str(requests / (scene + '.json')), '--label', 'small-pile-full-' + scene + '-' + label,
            '--out', str(out), '--profile', 'VeryHigh', '--dop', '16', '--budget-ms', '300000', '--search-mode', 'Coordinator',
            '--nodes', str(nodes), '--beam', '135', '--card-branches', '72', '--pile-branches', '42', '--hand-branches', '54',
            '--enable-no-gc-region', '--no-gc-region-budget-gigabytes', '16', '--use-portfolio', '--production-budget']
        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('OFFLINE_', 'COMBATSOLVER_VERIFY_', 'COMBATSOLVER_TASK_', 'COMPlus_', 'DOTNET_'))}
        env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL'] = str(dll)
        record = {'scene': scene, 'label': label, 'command': cmd, 'outerTimeoutSeconds': 120,
            'environmentOverrides': {'OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL': str(dll)},
            'dllSha256': hashlib.sha256(dll.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'hostSha256': hashlib.sha256(host.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'requestSha256': hashlib.sha256((requests / (scene + '.json')).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'cpuAffinity': sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)), 'diagnosticInstrumentation': False, 'temporaryCompiledTestCode': False}
        (out / 'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2))
        started = time.monotonic()
        print('START ' + scene + ' ' + label, flush=True)
        timed = False
        with (out / 'stdout.log').open('w') as stdout, (out / 'stderr.log').open('w') as stderr:
            p = subprocess.Popen(cmd, env=env, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, start_new_session=True)
            try:
                code = p.wait(timeout=120)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                timed = True
                os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                try:
                    code = p.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    code = p.wait()
        record.update(exitCode=code, timedOut=timed, processWallSeconds=time.monotonic() - started)
        if (out / 'result.json').exists():
            x = json.loads((out / 'result.json').read_text())
            h = json.loads((out / 'harness-result.json').read_text())
            record.update(wallSeconds=x['wallSeconds'], peakProcessWorkingSetBytes=x['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'],
                quality=json.loads((out / 'quality.json').read_text()),
                rootContinuationStamp=x['rootContinuationStamp'], searchPolicy=json.loads((out / 'search-policy.json').read_text()),
                budget=x['budget'], status=x['status'], timeBoundaryObserved=x['timeBoundaryObserved'], solverMetrics=x['solverMetrics'],
                rootLiveEqual=h['search']['rootLiveStamp'] == x['rootContinuationStamp'])
        scene_records.append(record)
        run_records.append(record)
        (t / 'full-runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(run_records, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        print(json.dumps({k: record.get(k) for k in ['scene', 'label', 'exitCode', 'timedOut', 'wallSeconds', 'peakProcessWorkingSetBytes']}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
        if code or timed:
            raise SystemExit('incomplete run; stop sequence')
        a1 = scene_records[0]
        equal = all(record[k] == a1[k] for k in ['quality', 'rootContinuationStamp', 'searchPolicy', 'budget', 'status'])
        equal = equal and record['rootLiveEqual'] and not record['timeBoundaryObserved']
        record['threeLogicalWorkFieldsEqualToFirstControl'] = all(record['solverMetrics'][k] == a1['solverMetrics'][k] for k in work_keys)
        record['allInputQualityChecksPass'] = equal
        (t / 'full-runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(run_records, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        if not equal:
            raise SystemExit('quality/input gate failed; stop sequence')
    a = [x for x in scene_records if x['label'][0] == 'A']
    c = [x for x in scene_records if x['label'][0] == 'C']
    ratio = statistics.median(x['wallSeconds'] for x in a) / statistics.median(x['wallSeconds'] for x in c)
    rss_ratio = max(x['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for x in c) / min(x['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for x in a)
    summary = {'scene': scene, 'ASeconds': [x['wallSeconds'] for x in a], 'CSeconds': [x['wallSeconds'] for x in c],
        'medianSpeedRatio': ratio, 'conservativeRssRatio': rss_ratio, 'allInputQualityChecksPass': True,
        'threshold': 1.03 if scene == 'dev-06-silent-boss' else 1.00,
        'passesRoiGate': ratio >= (1.03 if scene == 'dev-06-silent-boss' else 1.00) and rss_ratio <= 1.10}
    summaries.append(summary)
    (t / 'full-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summaries, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    if not summary['passesRoiGate']:
        print('Complete-request ROI gate failed; do not advance to final regression.', flush=True)
        break
